svg.title: Janeway Leaflet — editable SVG
svg.desc: Editable vector reconstruction of Janeway leaflet overlay. Token and die symbols link to individual print icon assets.

g.text: these tokens for one of the following effects:
Spend 1: Reroll any one of your own dice.
Spend 4: Select one of your opponents dice to
force them to reroll it, or change any one of
your dice to any value except six.
Spend 5: Change one of your dice to a six.
The next time a player with this token
would play a Roll Phase Action card,
Reprimand token to play the card. Then
